channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.
